name: Ball Bearings
summary: Utilize: scatter in a 10-ft square; creatures entering make a DC 10 Dex save or fall Prone.
text: As a Utilize action, you spill the bearings from their pouch across a level 10-foot-square area within 10 feet of you. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. Gathering the bearings back up takes 10 minutes.
